entities.summary: Shantanu Moitra (b. 1968-01-22, Lucknow) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Lucknow and India. Known in the fields of india, composers & musicians, asia.
